name: Persian Lexicon Project (PLP)
description: Frequency and orthographic-neighborhood dictionary covering 64,546 words, plus nonword materials and a visual lexical-decision dataset (1,800 items).

name: PSR Corpus
description: Persian Sentence Reading corpus of eye movements: 99 sentences, 60 adult readers, 60,575 valid word-by-reader observations, with fixation measures and predictability data.

name: ShEMO
description: Large-scale validated database for Persian speech emotion detection: 3,000 semi-natural utterances from radio plays, ~3h25m, 87 speakers, 5 basic emotions + neutral.

name: LCC Metaphor Datasets (Farsi)
description: Farsi component of the LCC Metaphor Datasets: XML data, graded metaphoricity, conceptual source–target mappings, and affect annotation. Larger release lists 80,167 source–target pairs.

name: Timed Picture Naming for 200 Objects
description: Persian measures for 200 color object pictures: name agreement, image agreement, familiarity, imageability, visual complexity, age of acquisition, and naming latency.
